scenarios.name: a fresh checkbox on the page: Did Mount in the first frame, Checked false, Enabled true, the three states false, Child Index and Children Count 0, This itself
a click ticks the box: Pointer Down, Focused (the press gives the input the keyboard), Pointer Up, Changed, with Checked true; a second click unticks it: Changed again, Checked false
Checked set from the graph: Checked sent, no Changed; set to what it already is: nothing; a truthy string ticks, 0 unticks
Check ticks an unticked box: Checked true, Done; Check again: Unchanged; Uncheck: Checked false, Done; Uncheck again: Unchanged — never Changed
a click on a ticked box the graph ticked unticks it with Changed: the person's toggle reads the node's state
two clicks in one frame: Checked ends where it began and is not sent, Changed fires twice
a disabled box takes no click, press, release or focus — the pointer still hovers it, and a finger reports nothing (C64)
with a label: a click on the box still ticks it, and the pointer events come from the wrapper the box sits in
the Focus action puts the keyboard on the input (Focused, Done); again: Done alone; Blur: Blurred, Done; again: Done alone
Enabled off and a Focus in the same frame: the box is still enabled on the page, so it takes the keyboard; in the next frame a Focus is Done and takes nothing
focused, then disabled: Focused stays true — a disabled element gives the keyboard up to nobody, so a Blur is Done and nothing fires; re-enabled, Blur takes it
Mounted off: Will Unmount; Checked keeps its value; a click finds nothing; Check still flips (the node, not the page); a Focus is Unchanged; Mounted on: Did Mount, Checked as left
Enabled follows its input as a boolean and is sent only on a change
Scroll Into View and every look or layout input change nothing on the wire

a person acts on a painted page: Mounted written off and an act in the same frame find no element (a Focus after it is Unchanged); written on, the act meets the element (a Focus after it is Done) — every act, both ways

a person acts on a painted page: Enabled written off and an act in the same frame meet a disabled element (a Focus after it takes nothing, a Blur gives nothing up); written on, an enabled one — every act, both ways
placed disabled: a Focus before the first frame is Done and takes nothing — the element was drawn disabled
a press held, then disabled and re-enabled across frames, then a click: Pressed true until the click's own release ends it

focused, then Mounted off and on: the leaving takes the keyboard and Focused with it — Will Unmount, Focused false and Blurred (D30); Did Mount; a Focus action puts the keyboard on the element that came back and fires Focused; a Tab away then fires Blurred
Enable Label turned off (after a Check) while the pointer is over the box: the label goes, the box stays where it is, and a leave afterwards still ends the hover
Enable Label turned off, then the Focus action: the box is on the page and takes the keyboard (Focused, Done)

a person acts on a painted page: Enabled and Mounted both written and an act in the same frame — off together (no element; a Focus after it Unchanged), on together (Did Mount, an enabled element) — every act, both ways
disabled and unmounted in one frame, then enabled and remounted in one frame, then a quiet frame: Did Mount once, Enabled true, and nothing more

a person acts on a painted page: Enabled off with Mounted on (a disabled element arrives: Did Mount, the act takes nothing, a Focus after it Done and nothing focused), then Enabled on with Mounted off (the element leaves) — every act, both ways
placed disabled, Mounted off then on with a press in the same frame: Did Mount and nothing else (a disabled element takes no press); a Focus after it Done and nothing focused; the same with a release

focused, then Enable Label turned on and a press in the same frame: the box keeps the keyboard — the press fires Pointer Down with Pressed and no Focused; turned off again, a Tab onto it finds the keyboard there already — the runtime rebuilds the input and the keyboard leaves with the old one, silently (the press fires Focused again: was row C80, fixed in P109 ISL-031)
Mounted off then on, and a Tab onto the box in the same frame: Did Mount and Focused together; the same with Enabled off: Did Mount alone, a Focus after it Done
a press held across a frame, then the release and a Blur action in the same frame: Pointer Up, then Blurred — the keyboard the press gave is still there to take away
focused, then the pointer onto the box and a Blur action in the same frame: Hover Start, then Blurred — a hover alone moves no keyboard
a click, an Uncheck and a click in one frame: the box ends ticked, Changed twice — the second click meets a box the Uncheck untick-ed
a Label that is an object with Enable Label on: the label is drawn as its text and the page keeps drawing
Visible off: a hidden box is under no pointer and takes no keyboard — every act raises nothing; the Focus action is Done with nothing; shown again, a click is a click
Visible off in the frame of an act: the act's paint hides the box first — the act raises nothing; one that held the keyboard keeps it (no focus fixup), and a blur takes it off
hidden, holding the keyboard: every pointer act meets nothing and takes nothing away — the Blur action after each finds the keyboard on the box (Blurred)

hidden and off the page: Mounted on and an act in the same frame — the act's paint puts the hidden box back (Did Mount) and the act meets nothing (a hidden element is under no pointer and takes no keyboard); a Focus action after it finds the box on the page (Done, takes nothing) — every act

hidden, holding the keyboard, Enable Label changed with every pointer act: the act meets nothing and the keyboard stays — the Blur action after each finds it on the box (Blurred); shown again, the box takes the keyboard (the Radio Button's scenario)

focused and under the pointer, then Mounted off, an act and a Focus action in one frame: the act's paint takes the element off the page, and Focused and Hover with it — Will Unmount, Blurred and Hover End (D30) — so the act finds nothing and the Focus is Unchanged; Mounted on: Did Mount; every act
